prompt_text: Where should I stay in Branson Missouri, an Airbnb or a hotel, and which specific places are best?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: it depends on what you want to do in Branson.

High-level guidance
- Choose a hotel if you want convenience, on-site services (restaurants, pools, daily cleaning, front desk help), easy walkability to shows/dining, or a one- or two-night stay. Hotels are also good for solo travelers and couples who want less fuss.
- Choose an Airbnb (cabin, condo, house) if you’re a family or group who wants more space and a kitchen, if you want a lakefront/dock experience, or if you’re staying several nights and want a lower per-person cost.

Where to stay by trip type (best picks and why)
1) For shows, restaurants and walkability (the “Strip” / downtown area)
- Hilton Promenade at Branson Landing (good location at Branson Landing, lakefront shops and evening fountain shows)
- Radisson Hotel Branson (central on 76, family-friendly, easy access to shows)
- Grand Country Inn / Grand Country Resort (classic family option on 76 Country Boulevard)
Why: short drives or walk to theaters, restaurants and evening entertainment; good if you’ll spend most time on the Strip.

2) For luxury and lake views / romantic couples
- Chateau on the Lake Resort, Spa & Convention Center (upscale, lakefront on Table Rock Lake, spa and fine dining)
- Big Cedar Lodge (nearby in the Ozarks — high-end resort experience, cabins, golf, outdoor activities)
Why: scenic, luxurious, great for romantic or restful stays and outdoor activities.

3) For families and groups who want space or a lake/cabin experience (Airbnb-style)
- Rent a Table Rock Lake cabin or a multi-bedroom lake house (private dock, kitchen, multiple living areas)
- Condos at Welk Resort / Still Waters / Big Cedar condo rentals (good for families who want resort amenities)
Why: more bedrooms, kitchens, better per-person value, great for multi-generational travel or longer stays.

4) For value / short stays / business travelers
- Thousand Hills Hotel & Conference Center (mid-range with amenities)
- Chain motels near 76 (Comfort Inn, Holiday Inn Express, etc.)
Why: predictable service, free breakfast, decent value.

What to look for in an Airbnb in Branson
- Location: “on Table Rock Lake” (if you want boating/docks), “near 76 Country Boulevard” or “near Branson Landing” (if you want shows/strip), or “near Silver Dollar City” (if that’s your main attraction).
- Amenities: private dock (lakefront), multiple bathrooms, kitchen, washer/dryer, central heat/AC, parking.
- Practical details: read the last 3 months of reviews, check cancellation policy, confirm dock/boat rules and parking, check drive times (Branson can get busy on 76).
- Safety & service: look for Superhosts or high-review properties and instant-book if you want easier planning.

Price expectations (very approximate)
- Budget hotel / motel: $70–130/night (off-season lower)
- Mid-range hotel: $120–220/night
- Upscale hotel / resort (Chateau, Big Cedar): $250–500+/night
- Airbnb cabins/large houses: $150–500+/night depending on size, lakefront, and season

Booking tips
- If you want shows on the Strip, staying within a 5–10 minute drive or walking distance saves a lot of taxi/Uber time.
- If boating is part of your trip, confirm dock/boat parking and lake access explicitly.
- For holiday or summer weekends, book well in advance (Branson fills up fast).
- Consider refundable/cancellable options if plans may change.

Quick tailored recs (if you tell me more)
- Couple wanting a romantic weekend: Chateau on the Lake or a private Table Rock Lake cabin.
- Family wanting Silver Dollar City + shows: a large Airbnb near Highway 76 or a condo at Welk Resort; alternatively a mid-range hotel on 76.
- Group wanting cabins and boating: a multi-bedroom lake house with a private dock at Table Rock Lake or Big Cedar Lodge cabins.
- Budget travelers: mid-week stays at chain hotels on 76 or condos a bit farther from the Strip.

If you tell me: travel dates, number of people, main activities (shows vs lake vs Silver Dollar City), and budget, I’ll give 3–5 specific, up-to-date hotel or Airbnb listings and which neighborhoods to target.
